Crop Disease Detection AI

Python · Computer Vision · Image Classification

A vision-based system trained to identify disease patterns in crop leaf images, aimed at giving farmers an early, low-cost way to catch problems before they spread. Built as an early portfolio project to apply classification techniques to a real-world dataset.

Bank Management System

Python · OOP · File-based persistence

A menu-driven CLI system built with a 3-person team as a Class 12 CS project, modeling core banking operations — account creation, deposits, withdrawals, balance enquiry, and account modification/closure — using an Account class and pickle-based file storage for persistence across sessions.
